Purity, Processing & Storage FAQs

Our Foxtail Millet has a recommended shelf life of 9 to 12 months from the date of cold-pressing/harvesting. Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. No chemical preservatives or anti-caking agents are added.
